notes.title: Minor Update - V0.2.4 - Quality of Life
notes.content:
Hi Puzzle Fans and Adventurers,

Today, we're excited to bring you one final minor update before reaching our next major milestone! Originally, we intended to include this update in our upcoming V0.3 release, but as that will still take a bit longer, we wanted to enhance the first room experience for new players right away.

🔎 [b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new animation for moving in and out when entering a puzzle
[*] Smoothed out the rotation of certain elements within puzzles
[*] Smaller objects now automatically move closer to the camera when picked up
[*] Certain on-screen messages now require interaction with the object that triggers the message, instead of simply looking at it
[*] Added a few new assets to explore and inspect in the first level
[/list]

🔎 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused [spoiler]elements in the umbrella stand puzzle to rotate incorrectly when multiple inputs were pressed simultaneously[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some audio cues to not play correctly when interacting with objects in the world
[/list]

[b]As we get closer and closer to releasing our next room, we wanted to share more pieces of our concept art and tease two upcoming puzzles:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/dafaf3e46eb25992c9e317a73246fbf72c4feca3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/8ab277e0a5c0d7747e9dab89c7f4705f3c616744.png[/img]

[b]Until next time![/b]

Cheers
The uqGames Team

notes.title: Minor Update - V0.2.3 - Full Controller Support
notes.content:
Puzzle Fans and Adventurers, 

As we approach the release of our next room, we're excited to share another update with you: 

[b]THE HALLWAY now fully supports controller gameplay.[/b]

🔎 [b]Full Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Simply plug and play with any controller on PC and Mac, or enjoy the game on Steam Deck while traveling or playing together with friends on the couch
[*] Several new settings found in the Gameplay Settings section
[list]
[*] Change the controller glyphs shown in the UI based on your device
[*] Inverse the Y-axis for the OGs among you :duke:
[/list]
[/list]

🔎 [b]Rooms[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a few new assets to explore and inspect in the first level
[/list]

[b]Until next time![/b]

Cheers
The uqGames Team

notes.title: Minor Update - V0.2.2
notes.content:
Puzzle Friends and Adventurers, 

Today we are releasing another small update to the first room to make it more lively and change the way you can acquire one needed item.

🔎[b] Puzzles[/b]

[list]
[*] New small puzzle to collect one of the map pins. Previously hidden behind a mask in the hay.
[/list]

🔎[b] Rooms[/b]

[list]
[*] Added multiple new assets around the first room to explore and inspect
[list]
[*] Filled out drawers under the candles with letters and a letter opener
[*] Umbrella stand (part of the new puzzle) with umbrella and walking cane
[/list][/list]

🔎[b] Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug [spoiler] that stopped the clock from opening after setting the correct time [/spoiler]
[/list]

[b]Please make sure to start a new game to experience the changes in the room. We'll make sure to include a level select option for future rooms in the main menu.[/b]

[h2]Concept Art Teaser for our next level[/h2]

Face the God of the Sun in a new set of puzzles in our upcoming second level! 
To already get you a little bit hyped, here are two of our very first concept art drafts for this next level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/37cf618b5ae74cd8425d17bda6398413699568c6.png[/img]

[b]Until next time![/b]

Cheers
The uqGames Team

notes.title: Minor Update - V0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello Puzzle Fans and Adventurers, 

today we are releasing a minor update to our first level! [/b]

[list]
[*] You can now collect four Steam achievements! Two of them are hidden, so explore the room thoroughly.  
[*] New depth of field focus when zooming on objects held in hand.
[*] We've moved the letter lock to the top of the candle table for better visibility. 
[*] Added a few new sounds to the world and interactions. 
[*] Several minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Until next time! [/b]

Cheers
The uqGames Team

notes.title: THE HALLWAY - Roadmap Update
notes.content:
Hello Puzzle-Fans and Adventurers,

Today we wanted to share with you our roadmap to bring THE HALLWAY into full release.

While we are working on our next level there is also still lots to be done in our first level. Here are just a few things that you can expect in following updates until we release the next level: 

[list]
[*] One more puzzle in the first room
[*] An illustrated background story to watch when starting a new game
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Multiple QoL Updates
[*] Localisation
[*] More objects in the room to make it even more lively
[/list]

Other than that, we hope you are as excited for the next level as we are! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/ed870c3edd445e6e8273ea304a4bee8bb1246d31.png[/img]

Catch you soon! 
The uqGames Team

notes.title: Thank you for your patience! THE HALLWAY - New Update coming soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Get Ready to Dive Back into THE HALLWAY![/h1]
[h2]Exciting Update Arrives in March[/h2]

Phew! It's been a wild ride since we released THE HALLWAY, and we're overwhelmed with gratitude for your incredible support!

We originally aimed for a quicker update, but the decision to rebuild the game entirely in Unreal Engine 5 took longer than anticipated. However, the wait is definitely worth it, and we can't wait for you to experience the all-new THE HALLWAY.

[h3]Mark your calendars: March brings a complete overhaul of the first room![/h3]

[b]Get ready for:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Stunning new graphics & art style[/b]: Immerse yourself in a visually breathtaking environment.
[*] [b]Fully interactive escape room:[/b] Every object is at your fingertips, offering even deeper engagement.
[*] [b]More mind-bending puzzles:[/b] Challenge yourself with a fresh set of brainteasers.
[*] [b]Personal player journal:[/b] Learn about the story, uncover clues, and jot down notes in your handy in-game journal.
[*] [b]Storytelling expansion:[/b] Dive deeper into the game's narrative with introductory glimpses into the backstory and future developments.
[/list]
As soon as the update drops, we'll share our updated roadmap, detailing when you can expect even more exciting content.

[h3]Enough talk though, let's see the magic! 
Feast your eyes on the new look of THE HALLWAY![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/689cc6a5b8c1467384abec346bea11b55803c952.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/bb343220e8160efe6e569cc917613b08cec55c83.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44517226/681353735ca7b15b1908e649195a363be5cf680b.png[/img]

[b]We're thrilled to start this next chapter with you. Stay tuned for more updates and let us know in the comments what you think of the new look![/b]

Cheers!
The uqGames Team
